label: Derived from a harness-authored synthetic session corpus (P4, R91). Its resemblance to real usage is unproven and was not tested: no real traffic exists to compare against (D3), and the corpus was declared unvalidated by choice rather than validated by a check. Its composition is a pre-registered design parameter -- 40 sessions across five families, 50% literal-bearing -- chosen for measurability, not realism, and its cache repeat rate is a dial, not an observation. Per-family figures are reported separately so any reweighting is arithmetic rather than a regeneration.
